game.title: Divinity: Original Sin 2
game.blurb: Party-based fantasy RPG with turn-based combat, from Larian Studios, released 2017-09-14. RAWG average playtime: 22 hours. Genres: RPG, Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Fort Joy
chapters.summary: Escaping the kraken, the prison island of Fort Joy, its arena and removing your Source Collar.

chapters.title: Driftwood and the Lady Vengeance
chapters.summary: Taking command of your ship, the Driftwood Arena, Meistr Siva, Tarquin and the Hall of Echoes.

chapters.title: The Nameless Isle
chapters.summary: The isle, its seven altars, the Academy and the Arena of the One.

chapters.title: Arx
chapters.summary: Arriving at Arx and the battle at sea.

chapters.title: Hidden Story Moments and Endings
chapters.summary: Secret story beats, companion turns and endings. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Source, Skills and Crafting
chapters.summary: Source skills and Source Point slots, crafting scrolls, skills and grenades, runes and talking to spirits.

chapters.title: Talking, Thieving and Side Deeds
chapters.summary: Persuasion, theft, getting caught breaking the law and rescuing Arhu.

chapters.title: Difficulty and Game Modes
chapters.summary: Finishing on Explorer, Classic, Tactician and Honour, plus Arena Mode and Game Master.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Divinity: Original Sin II" or "Divinity: Original Sin 2". divinity.fandom.com answers the API under "Divinity: Original Sin II", with about 64 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app 435150 is listed in the Steam store list as "Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition", but its achievement schema calls it "Divinity: Original Sin 2"; RAWG has separate entries for the original (10073, used here) and the Definitive Edition (59199). 55 of 97 Steam achievements are hidden, more than half; they all sit in one "Hidden Story Moments and Endings" chapter rather than being spread across the story chapters by guesswork. The story chapters follow the place names in the visible achievements (Fort Joy, Lady Vengeance and Driftwood, Nameless Isle, Arx). "Arrive at Reaper's Eye", "Face a higher power" and "Arrive at the Sanctuary of Amadia" do not name Fort Joy; they were put in that chapter by schema position and high unlock rate, which needs checking. "Help free Mari" and "Escort Saheila" were put with Driftwood by schema position. "Cat Person" (rescue Arhu) went to the side deeds chapter because the data gives no place.
